Since 1985, the Institute of Northern Engineering (INE)
has been the research engine of the University of Alaska Fairbanks College of Engineering and Mines.
INE is home to cold climate experts with a network of labs and centers
driving innovation across the North.
About INE
Research for the real world
INE tackles infrastructure, energy, and water challenges with
research-driven solutions. Our collaborative research turns
abstract questions into practical solutions,
driving work that matters to both science and industry.
